subject: NovaCorp — security onboarding: questionnaire & timeline
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Patel <lina.patel@novacorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: NovaCorp — security onboarding: questionnaire & timeline

Hi Lina — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our discovery and the asks we discussed so we can align next steps: 

- SOC 2: you mentioned an SOC 2 Type II report is in progress; estimated completion: Q1 2027. Can you confirm the scope (in-scope systems and data processing)?
- Reg compliance: you indicated NovaCorp needs HIPAA controls for the customer data path and GDPR data subject access support — can you confirm whether the contract will include HIPAA-specific BAAs and which EU regions you expect traffic from?
- Questionnaire: you asked about SIG vs CAIQ. Redwood typically supports both and can prefill a CAIQ skeleton for speed. Who on your side will be the validator for the questionnaire (security contact + procurement)?
- Evidence: we can attach an SOC 2 summary and an exported CAIQ prefill for review. Is there a preferred delivery method (DocuSign, SharePoint, email ZIP)?
- Timeline: you mentioned an internal 2-week review window after we submit documents; does that still hold?

Planned next steps from our side:
1) Share a short SOC 2 executive summary and a CAIQ prefill (we can prefill answers for common infra/control items).
2) If you prefer, we can create a SIG/CAIQ bundle and route it to your security contact and procurement.
3) Align on acceptance criteria and evidence owners so we don't hit back-and-forth later.

Attachments: redwood_soc2_summary_v1.pdf (SOC 2 exec summary)

If you confirm Lina + procurement contact, we'll push the CAIQ prefill today and mark action items for Marissa to coordinate follow-up.

Thanks,
Jonas
Sr. Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Lina Patel <lina.patel@novacorp.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Desai <samir.desai@novacorp.com>, Procurement <procurement@novacorp.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NovaCorp — security onboarding: questionnaire & timeline

Jonas — thanks for the clear recap and for the SOC 2 summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- SOC 2: correct, Type II in progress; scope covers platform services and production data stores. Expected completion: mid-Feb 2027. We can share the SOC 2 point of contact once finalized.
- HIPAA/GDPR: we are a covered entity for certain lines of business and will require a BAA. EU traffic is limited to ireland and germany at present.
- Questionnaire owner: security validation will be handled by Samir (cc'd). Procurement will own contract signature and vendor intake (procurement@novacorp.com).
- Preference: we prefer a prefilled CAIQ (xlsx) so our team can validate answers quickly — please send with any supporting evidence links. Delivery via email is fine, and DocuSign only for legal/BAA.
- Timeline: 10 business days review after receipt would be ideal for us.

I've attached our internal vendor intake form to this thread — it contains fields our procurement team requires (vendor ID, subprocessor list, contact for BG checks).

Attachment: novacorp_vendor_intake_form.pdf

Lina
Head of Information Security
NovaCorp
